project_type: Spring Boot 3 / Java 17 backend (Maven) + Angular 20 standalone-component frontend
build_system: Maven wrapper (mvnw.cmd) for backend; Angular CLI (ng) for frontend. Hibernate ddl-auto=update so new entity fields are column-added automatically on boot.
test_framework: No unit tests exist in the codebase; compilation success is the verification gate.
build_command: cd c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\backend && .\mvnw.cmd compile   (backend)  |  cd c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\frontend\learnplay && ng build  (frontend)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `.\mvnw.cmd compile` from c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\backend — must exit 0 with BUILD SUCCESS. 2. Run `ng build` from c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\frontend\learnplay — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: MapStruct generates LessonMapper implementation at compile time under target/generated-sources. No checked-in generated files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell shell. Backend runs on port 8112. Do NOT restart the running backend server. Africa's Talking sandbox credentials are in application.yaml: username=sandbox, api-key from AT_API_KEY env var. Dev mode guard: StringUtils.isDevMode() returns true when env SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE contains 'dev'.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code patterns: Lombok on entities, @Repository interfaces with JPQL @Query, @Service with @RequiredArgsConstructor @Slf4j, @RestController with @RequestMapping. Standalone Angular components with FormsModule [(ngModel)] two-way binding and Tailwind CSS classes.
key_patterns: Entity fields: plain Java types, no extra JPA annotations for simple columns. ID: set in @PrePersist via UuidGenerator.generateEntityUuid('prefix'). DTOs: extend BaseDto (holds id), plain Lombok @Getter @Setter @AllArgsConstructor @NoArgsConstructor. MapStruct mapper has ReportingPolicy.IGNORE so new matching fields auto-map. updateLesson uses QueryDSL JPAUpdateClause — every field being updated needs an explicit update.set() call. ATService methods are @Async('asyncTaskExecutor') and each checks StringUtils.isDevMode() at top. Frontend: standalone components, CommonModule + FormsModule imported directly. lesson-card.html uses *ngIf directives. Teacher form binds individual component properties via [(ngModel)] and assembles a plain object in saveLesson().
directory_structure: backend/src/main/java/com/softkit/wazi/ — entities/ (JPA entities), model/ (DTOs), service/ (business logic), controller/ (REST endpoints), repository/ (Spring Data repos), mapper/ (MapStruct), component/ (scheduled tasks — NEW), util/ (helpers). frontend/learnplay/src/app/ — kid/ (learner-facing: components, services, reusable), teacher/ (teacher-facing: components, services), shared/ (notification, spinner, toast).
